2610.11153.title: CARE: Constrained Attention Refinement for Fine-Grained Visual Classification via Teacher-Student Distillation
2610.11153.paper_summary: Fine-grained visual classification requires models to recognize subtle local traits while exposing the visual evidence behind their predictions. Class-specific attention pathways provide a natural basis for interpretable recognition, but their constrained prediction structure limits discriminative capacity and underuses intermediate representations from strong pretrained backbones. To address this problem, we propose CARE, a constrained attention refinement framework for interpretable fine-grained recognition via teacher-student distillation. CARE keeps the final prediction and explanation within a class-specific attention student, while introducing a training-only auxiliary query teacher that reads selected intermediate DINOv2 layers with learnable queries. The teacher fuses multi-level representations and transfers logit-standardized class-discriminative knowledge to the student. To further refine the explanation pathway, we design diversity and sparsity terms to regularize student attention heads, reducing redundancy and encouraging compact trait localization. Experiments on CUB, Oxford-IIIT Pet, Stanford Dogs, and Stanford Cars show that CARE achieves strong classification performance under an interpretable frozen-backbone setting, reaching 78.5% Top-1 accuracy on CUB. Faithfulness analysis with insertion and deletion metrics further indicates that the top-ranked attention regions retain class-relevant evidence for explanation.
2610.11153.paper_summary_zh: 細粒度視覺分類要求模型識別細微的局部特徵，同時揭示其預測背後的視覺證據。特定類別的注意力路徑為可解釋的識別提供了自然的基礎，但其受限的預測結構限制了判別能力，並未充分利用來自強大預訓練骨幹的中間表示。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了CARE，一個通過教師-學生蒸餾的可解釋細粒度識別的受限注意力精煉框架。CARE將最終預測和解釋保持在特定類別的注意力學生內，同時引入一個僅用於訓練的輔助查詢教師，該教師使用可學習的查詢讀取選定的中間DINOv2層。教師融合多層次的表示，並將對數標準化的類別判別知識轉移給學生。為了進一步精煉解釋路徑，我們設計了多樣性和稀疏性項來正則化學生的注意力頭，減少冗餘並鼓勵緊湊的特徵定位。在CUB、Oxford-IIIT Pet、Stanford Dogs和Stanford Cars上的實驗顯示，CARE在可解釋的凍結骨幹設置下達到了強大的分類性能，在CUB上達到78.5%的Top-1準確率。使用插入和刪除指標的忠實度分析進一步表明，排名最高的注意力區域保留了與類別相關的解釋證據。
